info.title: National API - Port API
info.description:
PortAPI is a rest full API for Finnish ports to send statistics data over to Nemo for Maritime statistics purpose and to request data for traffic taking place in Finnish ports. The National API now uses MIG 1.0.0.0 and 2.0.0.0 versions. You can find the information needed to make a valid request at the address https://fintraffic-vts.github.io/mnsw/ : \ - National rules and EMSA rules, conditions and guidelines \ - List of data elements suggested by Finnish authorities to use, whn submitting formalities \ - MIG JSON schema definitions \ - Nemo codelists \ - Guides Each request to the API must be authenticated with a JWT token. The token must be obtained from the IDP (Identity Provider) using the client credentials flow.
How to get JWT token for port organization ```bash curl -X POST 'https:///realms/nemo/protocol/openid-connect/token' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \ -d 'client_id=' \ -d 'client_secret=' \ -d 'grant_type=client_credentials' ``` IDP - DEV: mnsw-dev.mnsw.fi/keycloak \ IDP - TST: mnsw-tst.mnsw.fi/keycloak \ IDP - STG: mnsw-stg.mnsw.fi/keycloak \ IDP - PRD: mnsw.mnsw.fi/keycloak Example request with CURL: ```bash curl --request GET 'https://mnsw-dev.mnsw.fi/port-api/v1/ports/data?endDate=2025-08-22&startDate=2025-08-01' \ --header 'Authorization: Bearer ' ```

tags.name: Ports
tags.description:
The national port API will enable ports to send statistics data over to Nemo for Maritime statistics purpose and to request data for traffic taking place in Finnish ports.
The API access and documentation will be shared by Fintraffic and is not publicly available compared to national declarant API.
Ports should have the following formalities available and the data they have: 
ATA, ATD, CGA, CGD, COA, CWA, CWD, HZA, HZD, MDH, MTS, NOA, NOD, PXA, PXD, SEC, SRV, VID, WAR and WAS

get.summary: Get list of all ship data including certificates

parameters.name: cfrId
parameters.description: Community Fleet Register Number (EU fishing ships).

parameters.name: eniId
parameters.description: European Number of Identification for inland ships.

parameters.name: otherId
parameters.description: Another unique ID if no IMO/MMSI are assigned.

403.description: Ship data can't be get due to lack of permissions

429.description: Too many requests. Rate limit exceeded. Retry after the duration indicated in the Retry-After response header.

get.description:
Request port formalities data for traffic taking place in Finnish ports.
If necessary, data can be queried for the desired period.
 Returns all saved formalities from the following formalities: ATA, ATD, CGA, CGD, COA, CWA, CWD, HZA, HZD, MDH, MTS, NOA, NOD, PXA, PXD, SEC, SRV, VID, WAR and WAS

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Searching by eta, where the date starts with the value of startDate. Format in YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Searching by eta, where the date ends with the value of endDate. Format in YYYY-MM-DD

400.description: Invalid request, port data cannot be retrieved

value.errorMessage: End date cannot be before start date

403.description: Port data can't be get due to lack of permissions

404.description: Information not found. The information you were trying to access could not be found, please try to select some other information

429.description: Too many requests. Rate limit exceeded. Retry after the duration indicated in the Retry-After response header.

Mlt2Statistics.description: Schema for reporting port call statistics, including vessel, cargo, and passenger information for maritime traffic analysis.

reportingPort.description: Location code of the reporting port (LOCODE)

imoNumber.description: IMO(International Maritime Organization) number of the vessel

mmsiNumber.description: MMSI (Maritime Mobile Service Identity) number of the vessel

callSign.description: Radio call sign of the vessel

otherId.description: Other identification number of the vessel

dateTimeOfArrival.description: ATA (Actual Time of Arrival) -formality - arrival time of the vessel

dateTimeOfDeparture.description: ATD (Actual Time of Departure) -formality - departure time of the vessel

arrivingInDomesticTraffic.description: Flag indicating if the vessel is arriving in domestic traffic (true), otherwise arriving in foreign traffic (false)

departingInDomesticTraffic.description: Flag indicating if the vessel is departing in domestic traffic (true), otherwise departing in foreign traffic (false)

specifiedOrigin.description: List of specified origins for this port call

specifiedDestination.description: List of specified destinations for this port call

Mlt2StatisticsPortCallInformationInnerIn.description: Inward cargo details for national API statistics payload

transito.description: Whether the cargo is in transit

transportEquipmentEmpty.description: Whether the transport equipment is empty

Mlt2StatisticsPortCallInformationInnerOu.description: Outward cargo details for national API statistics payload

transito.description: Whether the cargo is transit cargo

transportEquipmentEmpty.description: Whether the transport equipment is empty

dayOfArrivalToCanal.description: Arrival date time to the Saimaa Canal (up)

dayOfDepartureFromCanal.description: Departure date time from the Saimaa Canal (down)

timeframeStart.description: Start time of the report time frame

timeframeEnd.description: End time of the report time frame

reportVersion.description: Version of the report format in format major.minor.patch (e.g., 1.0.0)

errors.description: Error messages related to the report

PortCallIntegrationDTOSpecifiedDestinati.description: Specified cargo for a specified destination, including vehicle type and quantity.

PortCallIntegrationDTOSpecifiedOriginInn.description: Specified origin for a port call, including loading port and inward passengers, and specified cargo.

specifiedCargo.description: List of specified cargo for this origin
